summary_en: SAKURA internet declared a special dividend of 2.50 yen per share with record date September 30, 2026, effective December 14, 2026, to commemorate its 30th anniversary on December 23, 2026. Total dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 is projected at 8.00 yen per share including this special payment.
title_en: Notice of Dividend of Surplus (30th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
SAKURA internet Inc. announced a special dividend of 2.50 yen per share to commemorate its 30th anniversary on December 23, 2026. The record date is September 30, 2026, and the dividend becomes effective on December 14, 2026. The company stated that this special payment reflects its gratitude to shareholders and related parties for their long-term support.

With this special dividend, the total dividend for the fiscal year ending March 2027 is projected at 8.00 yen per share. This comprises an interim dividend of 5.50 yen per share at the second quarter and the 30th anniversary commemorative dividend of 2.50 yen per share at the fiscal year-end, compared to the previously projected total of 5.50 yen per share announced on April 27, 2026.

The dividend is paid from retained earnings. The company expressed its commitment to sustained enhancement of corporate value and requested continued support from shareholders.
